Crypt of the NecroDancer (2015) — Brace Yourself Games

Genre: Rhythm Roguelike | Perspective: Top-down 2D Grid | Players: 1–3 Local Co-op | Steam Rating: 95% Positive

🎮 Core Concept

A roguelike where every action must be performed to the beat of the music. Move, attack, and dodge on a grid while maintaining rhythm. Combines musical skill with dungeon-crawling strategy.

👤 Characters (13+)

Character Gimmick
Cadence Standard play
Bard No beat requirement (beginner)
Melody Must always pick up items near her
Eli Bombs only — no weapons
Dorian 1 HP (boots give extra life)
Monk Dies if picks up gold
Dove Can't kill enemies (forced pacifist)
Bolt Double-speed music
Aria Everything kills in 1 hit, reverse weapons, dies if misses beat
Coda Everything lethal, double speed, misses beat = death
+ more Various extreme challenges

🎵 Core Mechanic — Rhythm Grid Movement

  • Move to the beat or lose your coin multiplier
  • Enemies have distinct movement patterns per beat
  • Learning enemy patterns is critical — each moves predictably
  • Missing a beat = lose damage multiplier + miss your turn
  • Custom Music Support — Import your own songs

🔫 Weapons & Items

  • Weapons: Broadsword (3-tile cleave), Spear (2-tile range), Whip (3-tile range), Cat o' Nine Tails, Rapier (lunge)
  • Armor: Leather, Chain, Plate, Glass, Obsidian
  • Spells: Fireball, Freeze, Shield, Heal, Bomb, Earth
  • Rings: Various passive bonuses
  • Torches/Shovels: Visibility and digging

📈 Progression

  • Character unlocks — Achievement-based
  • Lobby upgrades — Unlock items for the item pool
  • No permanent power — Pure skill + rhythm mastery
  • Daily Challenges — Seeded runs, global leaderboards

🏆 Leaderboards

  • Daily challenge scores — Compete globally on same seed
  • Speed run leaderboards — Per character
  • All-zones score runs — Total score across all levels

🌟 Key Innovation

Rhythm + Roguelike — Entirely novel fusion. Music replaces turn timer. Created a whole subgenre (Cadence of Hyrule for Zelda).

📊 Key Stats

  • Characters: 13+
  • Zones: 5
  • Daily challenges: Yes
  • Average run: 20–30 minutes
  • Metacritic: 87/100
  • DLC: Amplified, Synchrony, + Cadence of Hyrule spin-off
